full_prompt_en: A square studio-style three-dimensional image shows a smiling blue-and-white plush character with raised arms on a pale blue background. The backdrop is smooth and nearly uniform, slightly darker toward the upper corners, and meets a matching floor along a faint horizontal seam near the bottom. At the center stands a small round-bodied figure, front-facing and fully visible from head to feet. The broad blue head frames an off-white face with very large white eyes; one eye is open with a tiny dark pupil, while the other forms a curved wink. A round red nose sits at the center above thin black whisker lines that fan across gently pink cheeks. The mouth opens widely in a cheerful arc, showing a deep burgundy interior and warm orange lower area. Short blue arms lift outward, ending in round white mitt-like hands. The compact blue body has a large off-white oval front panel with a softly outlined pocket. A red collar circles the neck and holds a small shiny golden bell at its center, just above the front panel. Two broad white feet sit together on the floor and cast a soft short shadow beneath the body. A fine fuzzy nap covers the blue and white surfaces, catching light along curved edges and making the form resemble a carefully lit plush toy. The color is clean and limited: powder blue, cream, red, pink, and a small metallic yellow highlight. Large softbox-like light from the upper left and front brightens the face, hands, and bell, while gentle cool shading rounds the sides. The overall composition is playful and uncluttered, giving a tactile, cheerful central form generous breathing space within a quiet blue studio field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形影棚式三维画面呈现一个蓝白毛绒角色，在浅蓝背景前举起双臂微笑。背景平滑且近乎均匀，向上方两角略暗，在接近底部的细水平线处与同色地面相接。中央一个圆润小人物正面站立，从头到脚完整可见。宽阔蓝色头部框住灰白面庞和极大的白眼；一只眼睁开，瞳孔细小，另一只弯成眨眼弧线。圆红鼻子居中，下面细黑胡须线在微粉的脸颊上向外散开。嘴巴欢快地大张成弧，露出深酒红内部与暖橙下部。短蓝手臂向外举起，末端是圆润白色手套般的手。紧凑蓝色身体正面有一大块灰白椭圆区域，上面是柔和勾线的口袋。红项圈环绕颈部，中央挂着一枚小而亮的金铃铛，位于正面区域上方。两只宽白脚并在地面上，身体下方留下短而柔软的阴影。细密绒毛覆盖蓝白表面，在弯曲边缘承接光，使形体像经过精心布光的毛绒玩具。颜色干净且受限制：粉蓝、奶油色、红、粉和一点金属黄亮光。左上前方大片柔光提亮面部、双手和铃铛，柔和冷影使两侧圆润。整体构图活泼且简洁，让可触、欢快的中央形体在安静蓝色影棚空间中拥有宽裕呼吸。
style_prompt_en: The studio-like three-dimensional rendering favors compact rounded volumes, soft fuzzy surface nap, and very clean color blocking. Powder blue and cream form the broad masses, with small saturated red, pink, and metallic gold accents placed at high-attention points. Curved edges catch soft light and remain slightly velvety rather than glossy, while one tiny reflective detail adds material contrast. Simple graphic lines and circular features stay precise against the plush texture. The background and floor share a close pastel hue, separated only by a faint seam and a short soft shadow, so the central form feels grounded without visual clutter. Broad frontal-left lighting creates gentle volume and avoids deep black shade. The composition is centered and fully contained with generous negative space. The overall effect is friendly and tactile, combining toy-like material realism with simplified animated proportions.
style_prompt_zh: 这种影棚般的三维渲染偏重紧凑圆润体积、柔软细密绒毛和非常干净的色块划分。粉蓝与奶油色形成宽阔主体色块，少量饱和红、粉和金属金色重音落在高注意力位置。弯曲边缘承接柔光，保持略带天鹅绒感而非发亮抛光，一处细小反光细节则添材料对比。简洁图形线与圆形特征在毛绒肌理前保持精确。背景和地面共享接近的粉彩色调，只由一条淡缝和一小片软影分开，使中央形体落地却不添杂乱。左前方宽阔照明制造柔和体积，避免浓黑阴影。构图居中且完整收容，周围留有宽裕空白。整体效果亲切且可触，把玩具般的材料真实感与简化动画比例结合起来。
theme_en: A smiling blue-and-white plush character with raised arms on a blue background
theme_zh: 蓝白毛绒角色在蓝色背景前举起双臂微笑
name: Doraemon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
